item.description:
You will never supass old soycraft. You have no players, you have no builds, you have no gems. You are a ripoff server twisted by braindead admins and rulecucking into a crude mockery of oldcraft’s perfection.
All the “validation” you get is two-faced and half-hearted. Behind your back soyteens mock you. Your server hosting provoders are disgusted and ashamed of you, your dwindling “playerbase” laugh at your ghoulish appearance behind closed doors.
'crafters are utterly repulsed by you. Thousands of years of evolution have allowed players to sniff out frauds with incredible efficiency. Even servers who “pass” look uncanny and unnatural to a player. Your butchered configuration is a dead giveaway. And even if you manage to get a drunk guy home with you, he’ll turn tail and bolt the second he gets a whiff of your griefed and destroyed spawn.
You will never be happy. You wrench out a fake smile every single morning and tell yourself it’s going to be ok, but deep inside you feel the depression creeping up like a weed, ready to crush you under the unbearable weight.
Eventually it’ll be too much to bear - you’ll stop the server, right click the server’s folder, click delete, and plunge into the cold abyss. Soyteens will find you, heartbroken but relieved that they no longer have to live with the unbearable shame and disappointment. They’ll bury you with a headstone marked with your server IP, and every passerby for the rest of eternity will know a rippoff server is buried there. Your files will decay and go back to the dust, and all that will remain of your legacy is a legacy that is unmistakably crap.
This is your fate. This is what you chose. There is no turning back.

IMPORTANT PLUGINS (YOU CAN USE!)

ImageFrame
This plugin allows you to put any image or gif you desire and make it into a mapart.
The two most important commands are as follows :

/imageframe select - Select item frames to put image maps on
/imageframe create <name> <url> <width> <height> - Create a new image map


MedievalFactions
With the help of This Plugin you can form Factions, spread your claims, declare wars, ally, vassalize other factions, you gain "power" which in turn lets you expand your factions' claim even more. During wars you can also conquer territory. ( only possible if you are at war with the targeted faction and if they have more land than power.)

https://github.com/Dans-Plugins/Medieval-Factions/wiki/Commands

SkinsRestorer
SkinsRestorer is a plugin that restores skins for offline mode servers & networks that gives the players ability to change their skins by typing a single command.

/sr applyskin to apply a skin, can be even random! (/sr help for more commands.)

If you want to choose a custom skin, simply do for example :

/skin set "Player Name" to use a skin of an already existing premium player

Dynmap
You can view the map on a website! Also compatible with MedievalFactions borders too.

-Earth server
-No neutrals, but you can be a vassal of another faction. In return for them protecting you, you need to provide worth to them. Its entirely up to them to decide that.

-Entire point is to be the strongest and kill until theres nobody left.

-No claims, but the mods could roll stuff back (Ideally mist wouldn't be the only mod. Maybe someone like baritone could be brought on)
